mainEntity.name: How do I seal the garage slab floor for habitable use?

acceptedAnswer.text: The concrete slab must be sealed with vapor retarder, insulated (R-19 typical), and covered with gypcrete, raised flooring, or finished subfloor to meet energy code and prevent moisture intrusion.
